raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet that showed Wikipedia listing Abdul Wahab Khan Tarzi’s death as 1999, without clicking through to verify the actual article content. This introduced a conflicting and likely incorrect date into the workflow, causing confusion and repeated verification loops. By not validating the primary source, the agent risked leading to the wrong comparison outcome (i.e., concluding Olaf Everson died first if 1999 were accepted), instead of the more credible 1994 date supported by Wikipedia/Wikidata.
